milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

issue.body:
# Legacy status

This tracker is superseded for all future architecture and sequencing by #820 and milestone 21, **Geometric Intelligence — route-native local engine**.

The prior hybrid destination—geometric support/memory around retained source tokenizer/embeddings/residual/norm/MLP/LM head and uor-matmul projections—is no longer the serving objective. Its implementation and measurement records remain valid historical evidence and negative controls.

## Why this issue remains open

#949 stays open only until #958 has a terminal delivery record and its artifacts are reconciled.

Reconciliation must:

- inventory every #958 production module, schema/manifest change, route registry/chart, operator, attention index, bounded probe, and evidence artifact;
- map each retained piece into S0 #961, A1 #952, or an explicitly named historical/control location;
- record any κ/manifest compatibility or migration requirement;
- distinguish implemented storage/recall/operator behavior from unestablished attention, semantic, inference, or product claims;
- update stale references that still present #949 as the programme authority; and
- post the final mapping here before closing #949.

Do not close #958 and do not mutate PR #960 as part of this tracker rewrite.

## Replacement boundary

The authoritative programme requires κ as identity/serialization rather than tokenizer; a separate canonical lexical codec; source weights only in an offline teacher; no serving transformer, MoE, dense-matmul, source-attention, Ollama, hosted provider, or equivalent fallback; and a load-bearing icosian store in which the E8 lattice is the Z-module of quaternions over Z[φ], represented as golden-coupled R4 pairs with fixed `H4 ⊕ φH4` folding and inverse witnesses.

Project shorthand **`E8 = H4 × H4`** names this paired mechanism; its normative implementation is the icosian golden-coupled `H4 ⊕ φH4` folding, not a literal Cartesian-product identity or an identification of R4 with E8.

## Blockers and activity

- **Legacy reconciliation only; unassigned.**
- Blocked on #958 terminal delivery/reconciliation.
- No new mechanism work belongs here.
- Routine testing is dormant. The only permitted check is the smallest read-only artifact-to-new-stage mapping needed to reconcile #958.
- New work follows #961 → #952 → #953 → #954 → #955 → #962 → #963 → #964 → #965 under #820.

## Legacy-scope preservation note — 2026-08-26

Before the tracker becomes a legacy reconciliation issue, preserve its prior scope:

- It tracked a hybrid provider-free decoder that routed through geometric support/memory but retained source tokenizer/embeddings, residual/norm/MLP/LM head, and uor-matmul learned projections.
- Its ordered plan was #950 seam → #951 one-layer qualification → #958 representation redesign → #952 all-layer attention replacement → #953 product/memory integration → #954 optimization → #955 freeze/lowering.
- It preserved R4G1 and W(3,3) as negative controls and required geometry/memory to be load-bearing before broader replacement.
- #951's 4.4416% relative-TLA result versus the fixed 5% threshold remained `REDESIGN_REPRESENTATION`, not promotion.

The replacement under #820 changes the serving destination to a route-native engine. It does not erase the hybrid implementation or measurement record.
